I built a personalized signal play for Softeon off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Softeon needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
